form_of_government.summary: Albemarle uses the county executive form of government. It has no elected Treasurer or Commissioner of the Revenue: the Department of Finance & Budget (Director of Finance) assesses and collects local taxes and issues business and dog licenses. The elected constitutional officers are the Sheriff, the Commonwealth's Attorney and the Clerk of the Circuit Court. The General Registrar is appointed by the Electoral Board.

notes: Method: www.albemarle.org (a Granicus site behind Akamai) answered every automated request with 403 Access Denied, including robots.txt, for the research User-Agent. The block was not circumvented. Official county pages were read from Internet Archive snapshots, almost all from March to October 2026 (each quote's read_via gives the snapshot; the one 2022 copy, the road-plans page, is flagged in its caveats), and every page quote was checked word for word against that copy. Pages on other official hosts were read directly at their robots.txt crawl delays: albemarleso.org (Sheriff), k12albemarle.org (schools, 5 s), rivannasolidwaste.org (10 s) and jmrl.org. serviceauthority.org (ACSA) also refused automated requests and was read from an archive copy. State-law quotes come from the lexflow Virginia Code index; all 100+ cited sections were looked up there. Coverage: the How Do I, Apply, Report, View, Get Assistance and Reserve hubs; every department in the site menu; the Community Development forms library and fee schedule; Finance (all business tax pages, personal property, real estate, relief, land use, appeals, procurement); Circuit Court Clerk, Sheriff, Commonwealth's Attorney and Elections; Police services; Fire Rescue permits and programs; Social Services and Office of Housing; Parks; Facilities & Environmental Services; GIS. Not readable: some pages were archived only as 403 pages or never archived, among them the burn-permit, SNAP, tax-relief and home-occupation How Do I pages, the Planning Commission page, the floodplain, VESCP, VSMP and central water/sewer application pages, the property inquiry page and the school construction sales tax referendum page. The processes still list their URLs from the site menu; their caveats say what was not read. Candidates not yet researched: agricultural-forestal district enrollment and the ACE conservation easement program (Community Development); Economic Development Authority grants and incentives; Albemarle-Charlottesville Regional Jail (a separate authority); VDH Blue Ridge Health District well and septic permits and VDOT entrance permits (state agencies required by county building permits); the General District and Juvenile and Domestic Relations District Courts (state courts); school meals, transportation and records requests (ACPS); the Town of Scottsville's own services. Privacy: county pages name many staff with personal mailboxes and direct lines (FOIA contacts, planners, inspectors, victim-witness staff, the Circuit Court Clerk's own mailbox). None are recorded. Only office main lines, published role mailboxes (tax@, payments@, clerk@, cddinquiry@ and similar) and portals are kept. Frequency fields are rough estimates from the size of the county (about 49,000 parcels per the Finance page), not county statistics. Fees, rates and deadlines are as shown on the archived pages (2026) and change yearly; confirm on the live page.
